# [TASK] Initialize Project Structure

## Task
Scaffold the directory structure for the backend modules, the frontend,
infrastructure and docs. This is the layout every later issue builds on.

## Parent Story
Parent: #83

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] All 9 backend modules exist, each with its own README.md
      (`ProjectStructureTest.everyBackendModuleHasAReadme`)
- [x] The frontend directory exists at `frontend/lmdb`
      (`ProjectStructureTest.scaffoldedDirectoriesExist`)
- [x] `infrastructure/` holds docker, kubernetes and scripts
      (`ProjectStructureTest.scaffoldedDirectoriesExist`)
- [x] `docs/` holds architecture/adr, api and guides
      (`ProjectStructureTest.scaffoldedDirectoriesExist`)
- [x] A root `.gitignore` is in place
      (`ProjectStructureTest.scaffoldedDirectoriesExist`)
